ayahs.1: Qasam hai aasman ki aur andhere mein roshan hone wale ki.
ayahs.2: Tujhe maloom bhi hai ke woh raat ko numaayaan hone wali cheez kya hai?
ayahs.4: Koi aisa nahin jis par nigehbaan farishta na ho.
ayahs.5: Insaan ko dekhna chaahiye ke woh kis cheez se paida kiya gaya hai.
ayahs.6: Woh ek uchhalte paani se paida kiya gaya hai.
ayahs.7: Jo peeth aur seene ke darmiyan se nikalta hai.
ayahs.8: Beshak woh use pher laane par yaqeenan qudrat rakhne wala hai.
ayahs.9: Jis din posheeda bhedon ki jaanch-partaal hogi.
ayahs.10: To na hoga us ke paas kuchh zor na madadgaar.
ayahs.12: Aur phatne wali zameen ki qasam!
ayahs.13: Beshak yeh (Quran) albatta do-took faisla karne wala kalaam hai.
ayahs.14: Yeh hansi ki (aur be-faayda) baat nahin.
ayahs.16: Aur main bhi ek chaal chal raha hoon.
ayahs.17: To kaafiron ko mohlat de, unhein thode dinon chhod de.
